story.text: 제주 게스트하우스의 아침은 이르게 시작됐다. 커튼 틈으로 새어 든 햇살에 눈을 떴을 땐 이미 방 안 가득 볕이 들어와 있었다.
story.reading: je-ju ge-seu-teu-ha-u-seu-ui a-chim-eun i-reu-ge si-jak-doet-da. keo-teun teum-eu-ro sae-eo deun haet-sal-e nun-eul tteoss-eul ttaen i-mi bang an ga-deuk byeot-i deul-eo wa iss-eot-da.
story.en: The morning at the Jeju guesthouse started early. By the time I opened my eyes to the sunlight slipping through the curtain gap, the room was already flooded with light.

story.text: 화들짝 놀라 시계를 보니 벌써 아홉 시가 다 되어 있었다. 마당에서는 늦잠 자는 걸 귀신같이 눈치챈 용우의 목소리가 들려왔다.
story.reading: hwa-deul-jjak nol-la si-gye-reul bo-ni beol-sseo a-hop si-ga da doe-eo iss-eot-da. ma-dang-e-seo-neun neut-jam ja-neun geol gwi-sin-gat-i nun-chi-chaen yong-u-ui mok-so-ri-ga deul-lyeo-wat-da.
story.en: I jolted up, startled — the clock already read nearly nine. From the courtyard, Yongwoo's voice rang out, as if he'd sensed my oversleeping like a ghost.

story.text: '야, 해가 중천인데 아직도 자냐. 빨리 안 나와?' 문 두드리는 소리가 이어졌다.
story.reading: ya, hae-ga jung-cheon-in-de a-jik-do ja-nya. ppal-li an na-wa? mun du-deu-ri-neun so-ri-ga i-eo-jyeot-da.
story.en: "Hey, the sun's already high in the sky and you're still asleep? Get out here." The knocking on the door kept going.

story.text: 허둥지둥 세수만 하고 나가자, 마당 평상에는 이미 아침상이 차려져 있었다. 그는 팔짱을 끼고 서서 기지개를 켜는 나를 못마땅한 눈으로 훑었다.
story.reading: heo-dung-ji-dung se-su-man ha-go na-ga-ja, ma-dang pyeong-sang-e-neun i-mi a-chim-sang-i cha-ryeo-jyeo iss-eot-da. geu-neun pal-jjang-eul kki-go seo-seo gi-ji-gae-reul kyeo-neun na-reul mot-mat-tang-han nun-eu-ro hult-eot-da.
story.en: I hurriedly washed my face and rushed out, only to find breakfast already laid out on the courtyard bench. He stood with his arms crossed, eyeing me with disapproval as I stretched.

story.text: '아직 잠이 덜 깼네.' 용우가 국그릇을 내 앞으로 밀어주며 말했다. 무뚝뚝한 손짓이었지만 국은 딱 먹기 좋은 온도였다.
story.reading: a-jik jam-i deol kkaen-ne. yong-u-ga guk-geu-reut-eul nae ap-eu-ro mil-eo-ju-myeo mal-haet-da. mu-ttuk-ttuk-han son-jit-i-eot-ji-man guk-eun ttak meok-gi jo-eun on-do-yeot-da.
story.en: "You're still not fully awake." Yongwoo said, sliding the soup bowl toward me. His gesture was gruff, but the soup was at exactly the right temperature to eat.

story.text: 밥을 먹으며 부스스한 머리를 손으로 대충 정리하자, 용우가 피식 웃으며 머리 위 까치집을 톡톡 건드렸다.
story.reading: bab-eul meog-eu-myeo bu-seu-seu-han meo-ri-reul son-eu-ro dae-chung jeong-ni-ha-ja, yong-u-ga pi-sik us-eu-myeo meo-ri wi kka-chi-jib-eul tok-tok geon-deu-ryeot-da.
story.en: As I ate and tried to smooth down my tousled hair with my hand, Yongwoo let out a short laugh and tapped the little bird's nest on top of my head.

story.text: '그래도 이렇게 하루를 시작하니 나쁘지 않네.' 그가 먼저 일어나 그릇을 정리하며 말했다. '다 먹었으면 나가자, 날씨 좋을 때 움직여야지.'
story.reading: geu-rae-do i-reo-ke ha-ru-reul si-jak-ha-ni na-ppeu-ji an-ne. geu-ga meon-jeo il-eo-na geu-reut-eul jeong-ni-ha-myeo mal-haet-da. da meog-eoss-eu-myeon na-ga-ja, nal-ssi jo-eul ttae um-jig-yeo-ya-ji.
story.en: "Still, starting the day like this isn't so bad." he said, standing up first and clearing the dishes. "If you're done eating, let's head out — better to move while the weather's good."

story.text: 아직 잠이 덜 깬 얼굴로 그를 따라나서면서도, 이런 아침이 매일이어도 나쁘지 않겠다고 생각했다.
story.reading: a-jik jam-i deol kkaen eol-gul-lo geu-reul tta-ra-na-seo-myeon-seo-do, i-reon a-chim-i mae-il-i-eo-do na-ppeu-ji an-ket-da-go saeng-gak-haet-da.
story.en: Still half-asleep, I followed him out the door, thinking that if every morning could be like this, it wouldn't be so bad.

words.example_en: I stretched wide the moment I got up.
I wasn't fully awake, so my words came out sluggish.

words.meaning: to look disheveled or tousled (esp. right after waking)
words.example_en: I looked in the mirror with my hair all tousled.
He starts every day with a walk.

sentences.ko: 늦잠을 자서 하마터면 아침을 놓칠 뻔했다.
sentences.reading: neut-jam-eul ja-seo ha-ma-teo-myeon a-chim-eul noch-il ppeon-haet-da
sentences.en: I overslept and nearly missed breakfast.
I stretched wide the moment I woke up.

sentences.ko: 아직 잠이 덜 깨서 정신이 없었다.
sentences.reading: a-jik jam-i deol kkae-seo jeong-sin-i eop-seot-da
sentences.en: I was still not fully awake, so I felt dazed.
I roughly fixed my tousled hair and headed out.
We started the day with a morning walk.

turns.speaker: 용우
turns.text: 야, 해가 중천인데 아직도 자? 얼른 씻고 나와라.
turns.reading: ya, hae-ga jung-cheon-in-de a-jik-do ja? eol-leun ssit-go na-wa-ra.
turns.en: Hey, the sun's already high and you're still asleep? Wash up and come out quick.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.en: Sorry, just a few more minutes...

turns.speaker: 용우
turns.text: 안 된다. 국 식는다, 얼른 나와.
turns.reading: an doen-da. guk sing-neun-da, eol-leun na-wa.
turns.en: No way. The soup's getting cold, come out now.

dialogues.question: 용우가 승객을 재촉한 이유로 가장 알맞은 것은?
dialogues.question_en: What best explains why Yongwoo hurried the passenger along?
dialogues.correct_answer: 국이 식기 전에 아침을 먹이고 싶어서
options: 국이 식기 전에 아침을 먹이고 싶어서
dialogues.explanation: 용우는 이미 차려놓은 아침이 식을까 봐 승객을 서둘러 깨웠습니다.

turns.speaker: 용우
turns.text: 오전엔 시간 있으니까 바다나 보러 갈까.
turns.reading: o-jeon-en si-gan iss-eu-ni-kka ba-da-na bo-reo gal-kka.
turns.en: I've got time this morning, want to go see the ocean?

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.en: Sounds great! But don't you have a flight today?

turns.speaker: 용우
turns.text: 새벽 비행 하나 끝냈다. 오후에 하나 더 있고.
turns.reading: sae-byeok bi-haeng ha-na kkeut-naet-da. o-hu-e ha-na deo it-go.
turns.en: I already finished one dawn flight. There's one more in the afternoon.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.en: So the morning's totally free, then.

dialogues.question: 이 대화를 통해 알 수 있는 용우의 오늘 일정은?
dialogues.question_en: Based on this conversation, what can you tell about Yongwoo's schedule today?
dialogues.correct_answer: 새벽 비행을 마쳤고 오후에 비행이 하나 더 있다
options: 새벽 비행을 마쳤고 오후에 비행이 하나 더 있다
dialogues.explanation: 용우는 새벽 비행을 이미 마쳤고, 오후에 비행이 하나 더 있어서 오전 시간이 비어 있다고 말했습니다.
